newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-VINGIS FIVE MONTH SALES 24.2 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-VINGIS FIVE MONTH SALES 24.2 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian electronic components producer Vilniaus Vingis said on Monday its sales in the first five months of the year rose to 24.2 million litas, a 23 percent rise over the same period in 1996.
Company director general Vaclovas Shleinota also told Reuters that the company was planning to boost its sales by 47 percent in 1997.
The company reported sales of 47.07 million litas in 1996 and 20.7 million litas for the first four months of the year.
The company also posted a 700,000 litas loss for the first four months.
The company earlier said that its shareholders decided to boost the share capital by 13.82 million litas and 25 percent of it will go to working capital to meet increasing demand.
